rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration was a P0 parity fix (previous behavior: Expo Go silently rendered '0 obs / NO RECENT HISTORY' while Web showed 10/10). Root cause was already fixed by E1 in this iteration: (1) backend adapter crash used to return 200 + empty obs — now raises HistoricalQueryFailed → HTTP 503 with detail.status=QUERY_FAILED; (2) backend response now includes explicit status enum + served_by fingerprint; (3) frontend never renders 'NO RECENT HISTORY' on fetch failure — instead shows 'HISTORY QUERY FAILED' + RETRY. All three mitigations verified via unit tests, HTTP tests, and Playwright end-to-end flows including 503 injection + retry recovery.
